story.zh: 羊祜、陆抗各守一方，彼此敬重，传为美谈。陆抗因羊祜所赠之药得以延寿，巡视边境时，修书邀羊祜一见。
story.en: Guarding their respective frontiers, Yang Hu and Lu Kang held deep mutual respect, a renown praised by all. Having prolonged his life thanks to medicine gifted by Yang Hu, Lu Kang penned a letter while patrolling the border, inviting Yang Hu to a meeting.

forbidden.zh: 主角为羊祜、陆抗、孙皓、司马炎时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Yang Hu, Lu Kang, Sun Hao, or Sima Yan.
